round.name: round_meta
round.sql: CREATE TABLE round_meta (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),profile TEXT NOT NULL,high_water INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(high_water>=0),meta_mac TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

round.name: round_ops
round.sql:
CREATE TABLE round_ops (
    round_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES round_rounds(round_id), op_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(op_hash)=64),
    request_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_digest)=64), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN('valid-swap','invalid-swap','valid-activation','invalid-activation','shuffled','abandoned')), receipt_mac TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(receipt_mac)=64),
    PRIMARY KEY(round_id,op_hash), UNIQUE(round_id,revision)
  ) STRICT

round.name: round_rounds
round.sql:
CREATE TABLE round_rounds (
    round_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(round_id)=43), owner_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(owner_hash)=64),
    create_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(create_hash)=64), create_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(create_digest)=64),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at>created_at), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 0 AND 128),
    state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768), state_mac TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_mac)=64),
    UNIQUE(owner_hash,create_hash)
  ) STRICT

reward.name: reward_claims
reward.sql:
CREATE TABLE reward_claims (
    nonce_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, round_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reward_rounds(round_hash),
    ad_unit TEXT NOT NULL, issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('pending','used')), tx_hash TEXT
  ) STRICT

reward.name: reward_meta
reward.sql: CREATE TABLE reward_meta (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),profile TEXT NOT NULL,high_water INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE reward_vouchers (

    nonce_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES reward_claims(nonce_hash), recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL, amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount=5), item TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(item='moves')
